messages.text: Hi Mira! Quick question — will Lingo Pod support European Portuguese, or only Brazilian?
Hi Sofia, thanks for backing us! Both are supported at launch — you can switch accents in the settings.
We're also adding Catalan and Basque as a stretch goal if we reach €120k 🙂
Just backed Verdant at the Premium tier! Does it ship to Sweden?
Thanks so much for your support. Your name will appear in the end credits!
Amazing! Can't wait for the premiere.
The first backer demo is live — check your email for your Steam key!
Hi Sofia, your identity verification is complete. You're all set to receive payouts.
